item.title: [8] Superconducting 2D cuprate with a single CuO2 plane
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Wei Ruan, Yuanbo Zhang

Authors: Hengsheng Luo, Dongjoon Song, Yijun Yu, et al.

Score 8/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: High-quality monolayer cuprate study probing Mott physics and quantum criticality, relevant to unconventional superconductivity.

Tags: #cuprates #monolayer #superconductivity

Abstract: A high-quality, pristine monolayer cuprate superconductor with a single CuO2 plane is fabricated and used to identify two quantum critical phenomena emerging between the Mott insulating phase and the superconducting phase.
